newsitem.title: INDIA: India grants 2.2 bln rupee loan to Maheshwar Hydro.
newsitem.headline: India grants 2.2 bln rupee loan to Maheshwar Hydro.

text.p: India's Power Finance Corp has sanctioned a term loan of 2.2 billion rupees to Maheshwar Hydro Electric Project, the Power Ministry said in a statement on Friday.
The loan includes a one billion rupee loan syndicated by the Industrial Finance Corp of India and a foreign currency direct loan of 1.2 billion rupees equivalent to $34 million, the ministry said.
Indian newspapers said the project is owned by U.S.-based Bechtel Corp, India's S. Kumar group and PacGen, a subsidiary of Pacific Corp.

"This is one of the few hydropower projects taken up in the private sector and the first to benefit from the Power Finance Corp, whose main customers are state-owned power utilities," the ministry said.
